artifacts.summary: Implementation summary for replacing sed patterns with awk single-pass in update-task-status.sh

completion_data.completion_summary: Replaced brittle sed two-step extraction+replacement in update_todo_task_entry and update_todo_task_order Mode A with awk single-pass using sub(/\[[A-Z ]+\]/, "[NEW_STATUS]"), adding non-zero exit codes for genuine failures instead of silent no-ops.

memory_candidates.content: When replacing sed status extraction+replacement patterns in bash scripts, use awk single-pass with `match($0, /\[([A-Z ]+)\]/, arr)` for extraction and `sub(/\[[A-Z ]+\]/, "[NEW]")`  for replacement. Capture awk output into a variable via `result=$(awk ... ) || { handle_failure; }` to prevent `set -euo pipefail` from aborting the script on a non-zero awk exit. Use `printf '%s\n'` (not echo) to write multiline awk output to a temp file to avoid trailing-newline corruption.
